$comment: Declared state of every VoxTable voice line — the machine-readable SSOT for the routing
chain. NUMBERS.md narrates this file; where they disagree, THIS file is what the checker
enforces and NUMBERS.md is the one that is stale.
Why it exists: the line is four bindings in four systems (Twilio trunk, Retell number
import, Retell agent, the restaurants row). Nothing referenced the others, so a binding
could vanish and only a human placing a call would find out. On 20 Aug 2026 three of the
four were broken at once on production and had been for a day.
Identifiers only. NEVER put an auth token, API key or webhook secret in here (NUMBERS.md §7).
Update this file in the SAME change as the vendor mutation, never afterwards.

retell_credentials.note: Production credentials come only from bp-voxtable-prod Secret Manager. Never use the repository .env or sandbox VM credentials for this line.

$greeting_disclosure_comment: The venue owner asked for the 'an AI assistant' phrase to be removed, 31 Aug 2026.

$trunk_posture_comment: Read back from the AU1 Trunking API on 2 Sep 2026 — NOT the tls + secure=true that NUMBERS.md
and this file's neighbours described. This is the posture set by the reversible experiment in
deploy/runbooks/incident-7600ms-call-drops.md §6 (Secure=false first, then origination
tls -> tcp) to test whether transport caused the ~7.6s drops. It did not: two more staging
drops on 30 Aug exonerated transport, production moved to US1 instead, and staging was never
reverted. Declared as-is so assert-line [19]/[20] guard the real trunk instead of skipping
under --strict — which is what turned Voice line health red from #359 onward.
Reverting to tls + secure=true is the §6 rollback and an OPEN decision: §6 requires 6 real
test calls to +61 468 203 234 to validate any trunk change, so it is not a repo-only action.
Change the trunk and this declaration in the SAME change, never one without the other.
